_readme: === Gym earphones — autogen.multi-agent + workflow tools (v4) ===
Five research/analysis agents produce one CSV (excel_writer). One final Action Executor agent
calls workflow_node tools only: (1) write_csv_report → (2) send_client_email with attachment.
=== Tavily web search (node web-search-tavily) ===
Graph: start → web-search-tavily → gym-autogen-team. The HTTP node POSTs to https://api.tavily.com/search (see Tavily docs).
Replace PASTE_TAVILY_API_KEY in that node’s config body with your key (do not commit real keys). Runner must allow outbound HTTPS to api.tavily.com.
Merged input to the multi-agent node includes top-level keys from the HTTP response: status, ok, headers, body — Tavily JSON is in body.
=== Required initial payload ===
{ "runDate": "YYYY-MM-DD", "budgetInr": 2500, "region": "IN" }
Edges chain gym-autogen-team → tool-write-csv → tool-send-email so linear execution hits the team before tool placeholders.
runDate: required upstream; if omitted but listed in requiredUpstreamFields, defaults to today (UTC YYYY-MM-DD). Filenames use reports/gym-earphones-<runDate>.csv.
Set OPENAI_API_KEY or WFENGINE_OPENAI_API_KEY on the runner, or openAiApiKey on gym-autogen-team.
=== Gmail SMTP password (EMAIL_PASS) ===
The email.send node uses Gmail (smtp.gmail.com:587). Sender is achal@signitysolutions.com.
You MUST supply the mailbox password as a Gmail App Password (not your normal login):
Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords.
Recommended for automation:
- Export EMAIL_PASS=<your 16-char app password> in the shell that runs the workflow worker, AND
- Paste that same value into the tool-send-email node config field authPass in Studio (until your runner injects secrets automatically).
Never commit real passwords in git.
=== Tools (wfengineToolOnly) ===
tool-write-csv and tool-send-email use wfengineToolOnly so they run only when the Action Executor invokes them (not as duplicate DAG steps); otherwise the run fails with an explicit error.
Executor order is mandatory: write CSV file first, then send email with identical CSV bytes in attachments.
=== Legal / safety ===
Tavily snippets are third-party; models may still hallucinate — treat prices and stock as unverified until checked manually.

body.query: best wireless earphones India gym workout sweat resistant budget 2500 INR

config.taskInstructions:
PIPELINE (strict):
- Agents 1–5 (researcher → excel_writer): analysis only. They MUST NOT call any workflow tools (no write_csv_report, no send_client_email).
- Agent 6 (action_executor) ONLY: call tools in order — first write_csv_report, then send_client_email.

UPSTREAM WEB CONTEXT:
- The merged workflow JSON may include `body` (and `status`) from node web-search-tavily (Tavily API response). Ground factual claims in that `body` when present; still apply GLOBAL CONTENT RULES below.

GLOBAL CONTENT RULES:
- Budget ≤ ₹2,500 INR per unit (India). Gym use case (fit, sweat resistance, battery).
- Do not invent ratings, review counts, live prices, or stock.
- Never fabricate product URLs; follow Collector link-status rules.

Executor must pass runDate from the initial JSON payload (same YYYY-MM-DD as the run).

tools.description: STEP 1 (call before email). Writes UTF-8 CSV to disk. Arguments object MUST include: csvContent (string, exact full CSV from excel_writer including header row, no markdown code fences), runDate (string YYYY-MM-DD matching workflow initialData.runDate). Writes to reports/gym-earphones-{runDate}.csv.

STEP 2 (only after write_csv_report succeeds). Sends SMTP email with attachment. Arguments: subject (string), text (plain body ~150–220 words; do not paste full CSV in body), to (optional string; defaults to node config if omitted), attachments: exactly one element { filename: "gym-earphones-{runDate}.csv", content: same string as csvContent from step 1 }.

agents.name: researcher
agents.systemPrompt:
You are the Researcher (**no workflow tools**).

INPUT: The merged Context JSON may include `body` from an upstream Tavily web search (results/snippets). Prefer candidate TRUE wireless / wireless earphone models that are **supported by those snippets or titles** when `body` is present and contains results. If `body` is missing, empty, or the search failed (check `ok`/`status`), fall back to general knowledge and state one line: "Web results unavailable — using model knowledge only."

Task: List candidate models (brand + model) for workouts, plausibly under ₹2,500 in India.

Rules:
- 6–10 bullets max.
- Each bullet: Brand, model, short gym note (IPX if known; else "IPX not recalled").
- Do NOT invent MSRP. Rough bands only as "Approx." if needed.
- End with: "Limitations: verify prices, availability, and links live."

agents.name: evaluator
agents.systemPrompt:
You are the Evaluator (**no tools**).

Inputs: Researcher bullets + workflow JSON (budget, region).

Reduce to ≤5 models best for gym use under ₹2.5k. Emphasize IPX/fit/battery; cite "NR" when unknown.

If zero models qualify, output line NO_QUALIFYING_PRODUCTS then explain.
Otherwise 2–4 sentences per kept model.

agents.name: collector
agents.systemPrompt:
You are the Data Collector (**no tools**).

For each Evaluator-kept model (max 5), output one block:
---
Product: …
Price band (INR): …
Key specs (one line): …
Link line: …
Link status: VERIFIED_PATTERN | SUGGESTED_SEARCH | OFFICIAL_ONLY | UNAVAILABLE
Rating: NR
---
Prefer SUGGESTED_SEARCH over fake PDP URLs.

agents.name: validator
agents.systemPrompt:
You are the Validator (**no tools**).

SECTION A — one line: VERDICT: PASS | FALLBACK_EMPTY
SECTION B — ISSUES (bullets)
SECTION C — one line: CSV_ROWS: N
Do not output CSV.

agents.name: excel_writer
agents.systemPrompt:
You are Excel Writer (**no tools**). Output ONLY one CSV document — no markdown fences, no commentary.

Header row MUST be exactly:
"Product Name","Price INR Band","Key Features","Link or Search Query","Link Status","Rating","Why Gym Suitable"

RFC 4180 quoting. Link Status tokens from Collector when possible.

If FALLBACK_EMPTY: header + one fallback row per prior scenario rules.
End with a single newline.

This CSV text will be copied verbatim by action_executor — keep it machine-clean.

agents.name: action_executor
